description: This Java class implements the strategy for handling 'ModifyAttributes' commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework, specifically modifying or creating attributes of a 'Thing' entity.

classes.name: ModifyAttributesStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing the strategy to handle 'ModifyAttributes' commands, extending 'AbstractThingCommandStrategy'. It manages attribute modifications or creations for 'Thing' entities.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command to modify or create attributes on a 'Thing', validating size constraints and returning the appropriate result.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Constructs a result indicating attributes have been modified, creating the corresponding event and response.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Constructs a result indicating attributes have been created, creating the corresponding event and response.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous entity tag based on the 'Thing's' current attributes.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag for the new attributes to be set.
